items.title: David Montgomery: Considered week-to-week
items.text:
Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Montgomery (groin) is considered week-to-week, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Could return to practice Week 6
items.text:
Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that Brown (ankle) has "a chance" to return to practice this week, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Will Shipley: Could face multi-week absence
items.text:
Shipley (foot) was diagnosed with a partial tear of his plantar fascia after exiting Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars in London and could be sidelined multiple weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ladd McConkey: Ends up sitting out Week 5 loss
items.text:
McConkey (foot) was active but didn't play any snaps in Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Headed for testing Monday
items.text:
Henderson (ankle) is slated to undergo further medical testing Monday after exiting Sunday's 45-17 win over the Raiders, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
